# Objective

Apply the three verified fourth-round review findings as one fix batch,
keeping the suite green and the documented policies in sync.

# Verified findings (all reproduced before fixing)

1. The batch-3 "commit point" was comment-only: after all publications, an
   exception from `input_file.close()` or the TemporaryDirectory cleanup
   still reached the rollback handlers and deleted every published output
   (`files after: []`).
2. Equal-start mates received `(tlen, tlen)` — both positive — violating
   the SAM TLEN opposite-sign rule; the (400,400) integration test pinned
   the invalid value.
3. Mixed paired/unpaired primaries were validated in slot-assignment
   order: an unpaired record followed by a paired R1 silently overwrote
   the slot (exit 0), while the reverse order raised (exit 1).

# Changes as executed

- `src/pairloom/pipeline.py`:
  - `committed` flag set immediately after the last publication; every
    exception handler skips rollback when committed, prints a post-commit
    warning (`_warn_committed`), and re-raises; OSError becomes an
    OutputError naming the post-commit state;
  - `_sync_mate_fields` equal-start tie: `(tlen, -tlen)`, read1 positive;
  - `process_template` validates the primary group as a whole before slot
    assignment (mixed paired/unpaired and multiple unpaired primaries both
    raise regardless of order).
- Tests: 4 regressions added — post-commit tempdir-cleanup failure keeps
  outputs (test_errors), colocated TLEN signs (test_integration),
  order-independent mixed rejection and double-unpaired rejection
  (test_classify_policy). One first-party expectation corrected:
  `test_joint_overlap_maximization` read2 TLEN 16 → -16. Suite 143 → 147.
- README: TLEN tie rule in the adjusted-records paragraph, the two-tier
  post-commit contract in the failure policy, test count 147.
- Benchmark re-measured (7.7 s, 2,590 pairs/s, 225 MiB — in range).

# Steps actually taken

1. Plan written; all three findings re-verified via the reproduction
   script (the first an explicit refutation of the batch-3 design).
2. Fixes applied; the (400,400) integration test failed as expected and
   its expectation was corrected to the SAM-conformant sign.
3. Four regressions added; ruff format applied to three files; full gates
   re-run.
4. Reproduction script re-run at the original bug sites: all three
   behaviors corrected; benchmark re-measured.

# Verification

- `pixi run test`: 147 passed (was 143; +4 regressions).
- Reproduction re-run: cleanup failure exits 1 with all outputs kept and
  the post-commit messages on stderr; colocated mates show `+20/-20`;
  both orders of the mixed template exit 1.
- `pixi run lint` / `pixi run format`: clean.
- Benchmark: 1 thread 7.7 s / 2,590 pairs/s / 225 MiB — within the
  documented range.

# Risks encountered

- None beyond the confirmed design decisions (read1-positive TLEN;
  two-tier post-commit contract), both documented in README and the
  report.
